description: This file contains helper functions for interacting with Deribit API, including fetching instruments, options, futures, ticker data, OHLC data, and related utilities. It is part of a larger project related to Deribit trading data.

methods.name: get_instruments
methods.description: Fetches Deribit instruments based on currency, derivative type, and expiration status.

methods.name: get_options_symbols
methods.description: Retrieves options contract symbols grouped by expiry date for a given underlying symbol.

methods.name: get_futures_curve_symbols
methods.description: Returns a list of futures symbols for a specified underlying.

methods.name: get_ticker_data
methods.description: Fetches ticker data for a specified instrument symbol.

methods.name: get_perpetual_symbols
methods.description: Returns a dictionary mapping short symbols to full perpetual instrument names.

methods.name: get_ohlc_data
methods.description: Retrieves OHLC trading data for a symbol within a date range and interval.

methods.name: check_ohlc_symbol
methods.description: Checks if a symbol has OHLC data available.

methods.name: get_futures_symbols
methods.description: Returns a list of all futures instrument names.

methods.name: get_futures_curve_by_hours_ago
methods.description: Retrieves futures curve data from a specified number of hours ago.
